name: Attitude
overview: Scripture reveals that attitude deeply impacts our spiritual and physical well-being, as a joyful heart is likened to medicine, while a broken spirit harms the body. Believers are called to be transformed by renewing their minds and adopting the mindset of Christ, which leads to doing all things without complaining. Focusing on what is true, pure, and praiseworthy cultivates a positive attitude aligned with God's will, demonstrating the necessity of a changed and right attitude for Christian living.
